about.title: About ToiletKort
about.intro: ToiletKort (TMap) is a free, open map of public toilets in Denmark. It is a hobby project with no advertising.
about.dataTitle: Where does the data come from?
about.data1: All toilets come from OpenStreetMap, a free map of the world made by volunteers. The data is refreshed regularly.
about.data2: Many toilets only have a location, so a lot is shown as “unknown”. If you find a mistake, you can fix it on OpenStreetMap using the “Edit on OpenStreetMap” link next to each toilet.
about.data3: Later you will be able to add and correct toilets directly on this site.
about.license1: Map data is © OpenStreetMap contributors and is available under the Open Database License (ODbL). ToiletKort's combined dataset is shared under the same licence.
about.license2: The map tiles come from OpenStreetMap and are licensed under CC BY-SA.
about.privacy1: You do not need an account to use the map.
about.privacy2: Your location is only used in your own browser to centre the map and measure distances. It is not sent to us.
about.privacy3: When you search for an address, we pass the search text on to OpenStreetMap's search service Nominatim. We do not store what you search for, and your IP address is not passed on.
about.privacy4: Map tiles are loaded directly from OpenStreetMap's servers, which therefore see your IP address, just as when you visit openstreetmap.org.
about.privacy5: This site uses no cookies. Your language choice is only stored in your own browser.
about.privacy6: The site runs on Cloudflare, which processes technical data such as IP addresses to deliver and protect the site.
